# 74298 - Quadruple 2-input multiplexer with storage

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74298.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74298.json)

|---|---|---|
| ![74298 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74298.png) | ![74298 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74298.png) | ![74298 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74298.png) |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 15,14,13,12 | QA..QD = stored bits | Outputs of the four flip-flops. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: falling edge of CLOCK

- WORD SELECT low: QA..QD = A1,B1,C1,D1 at the falling clock edge
- WORD SELECT high: QA..QD = A2,B2,C2,D2 at the falling clock edge
- CLOCK high (no falling edge): hold

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLOCK | QA..QD | PLH | 18 | 27 |
| CLOCK | QA..QD | PHL | 21 | 32 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulseWidth | CLOCK |  | 20 |
| setup | data | CLOCK falling | 15 |
| setup | WORD SELECT | CLOCK falling | 25 |
| hold | data | CLOCK falling | 5 |
| hold | WORD SELECT | CLOCK falling | 0 |

## Not known

- The switching table names no input for its single tPLH/tPHL pair; recorded as clock to output (the only path that drives the outputs).
- No maximum clock frequency printed for the SN74298.
- No minimum propagation delays printed.
